tips.title: Define machine and material
tips.body: Create a new machine named 'DMU50' with parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define fixture
tips.body: Create a new fixture and select it in the Model dialog box.

tips.title: Set machine setup parameters
tips.body: Ensure the visibility of 'Solid1' is switched on and set the Machining level to 3 in the Technology Wizard.

tips.title: Select tool and holder
tips.body: Add an END MILL tool and select the HSK A 63 ER 32x80 holder with collision protection.

tips.title: Configure roughing operation parameters
tips.body: Set the Machining level to 3, enter depth of cut, stepover, and feed as shown in the image.

tips.title: Set tool path parameters
tips.body: Select the 'Shortest distance' strategy, set pass parameters, and configure links as shown in the image.

tips.title: Simulate operation
tips.body: Run SolidVerify simulation and verify the tool path as shown in the image.

tips.title: Add HSR operation
tips.body: Create a new HSR operation, select HM Roughing technology, and set parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Configure SWARF machining parameters
tips.body: Select the 'Shortest distance' strategy, set corner faces, and configure tool path parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Select Linear machining technology for roughing operations
tips.body: Click 'Linear machining' in the Technology list.

tips.title: Set tool to BALL NOSE MILL for roughing operations
tips.body: Select 'BALL NOSE MILL' from the tool selection menu.

tips.title: Use User-defined boundary for constraint boundaries
tips.body: Select 'User-defined boundary' and set the boundary curve as shown in the image.

tips.title: Set lead in and lead out radius for retracts
tips.body: Enter '10' as the Lead in radius and lead out radius.

tips.title: Select Radial roughing in Multiaxis machining technology
tips.body: Click 'Radial roughing' in the Technology list for Multiaxis Machining.

tips.title: Set stock to leave on value for Multiaxis machining
tips.body: Enter '0.5 mm' as the Stock to leave on value.

tips.title: Select Adaptive strategy for the next operation
tips.body: Click 'Adaptive' in the Strategy list under Geometry page.

tips.title: Set step down values for the next operation
tips.body: Enter the Step down values as shown in the image.
